verdict.rationale: A government IP office could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec for trade mark or patent data, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an API, OpenAPI, or any downloadable machine-readable spec. The evidence covers only web guidance, online and paper filing, and search pages, and the probe found the search host restricted to robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
